plugins.name: financial-accounting
plugins.description: Financial institution accounting fundamentals (journals, ledgers, sub-ledgers, chart of accounts) and US GAAP (FASB ASC) reference for FI operations.

plugins.name: financial-regs
plugins.description: US financial regulation lookup and compliance analysis.

plugins.name: jh-design-system
plugins.description: Jack Henry Design System (jackhenry.design/v2) — components, foundations, tokens, content.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: Go language best practices — Effective Go, Google + Uber style guides, Code Review Comments, modern stdlib (errors, context, slog, generics).

plugins.name: spanner
plugins.description: Google Cloud Spanner best practices — schema design, interleaving, indexes, transactions, query/DML optimization, schema evolution, and the Go client SDK.

plugins.name: sqlite
plugins.description: SQLite best practices — STRICT tables, the must-set pragmas (WAL, busy_timeout, foreign_keys, synchronous=NORMAL), BEGIN IMMEDIATE vs DEFERRED, indexes and EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN, JSON1/JSONB with generated-column indexing, the Go client (database/sql with mattn/go-sqlite3 or modernc.org/sqlite), and server-side production use (Litestream/LiteFS/Turso/D1).

plugins.name: pubsub
plugins.description: Google Cloud Pub/Sub best practices — topics & schemas, subscription types, delivery guarantees, ordering, dead-letter, ack deadline / lease, publisher batching, and the Go client SDK.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript best practices — type system, generics, utility & advanced types, discriminated unions, classes & OOP, error handling, async & cancellation, immutability, modules, strict tsconfig, naming, testing, plus a dedicated section on functional patterns.

plugins.name: commit-story
plugins.description: Take a batch of uncommitted work and split it into a sequence of meaningful commits with reviewer-grade messages, while guaranteeing the final tree is byte-identical to the starting tree. Plans the commit sequence, presents it for approval, executes whole-file or hunk-level splits via git apply --cached, and verifies the result with diff and tree-hash comparisons. Snapshots the baseline as a stash up front so any failure can be safely rolled back.

plugins.name: github-twin
plugins.description: Personal RAG over your GitHub history (commits, code, review comments), served to Claude Code over MCP. Provides find_code, find_reviews, predict_review_outcome, house_rules, developer_profile, and related tools.
